about: Linda Coberly is an attorney providing legal services covering Appellate, Personal Injury - Products: Defense and Securities Litigation.

Linda Coberly, who practices law in Chicago, Illinois, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2006 - 2027. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, she studied at The University of Michigan Law School. She graduated in 1995. After passing the bar exam, she was admitted to legal practice in 1996.
